item.title: Backpacks & Stuff Add-On
item.creator: Humblebright Studio
item.description:
Upgrade your survival with the Backpack & Stuff Add-On!
Equip 4 utilities at once: mix actions, combat, and adventure.
This backpack features 2000+ combinations and 30+ skins.
- Auto-Feed & Smelting
- Scuba Tanks & Jetpack
- Teleport & Dynamic Light

Apply this Add-On to your world and expand your storage!

faqEntries.heading: Does the backpack replace my chestplate?
faqEntries.content: It goes in the chest slot, so you wear one or the other. The backpack gives 4 armor points and it never burns in lava.

faqEntries.heading: How many items can I carry?
faqEntries.content: 78 items, spread over 3 storage pages inside the backpack, plus 4 slots for upgrades.

faqEntries.heading: Does it work on phone and tablet?
faqEntries.content: Yes. The first time you open a backpack it asks whether you use the Pocket UI, and the menus are laid out for touch. Run /hb_bps:pocket_ui to change it later.

faqEntries.heading: Why did an upgrade pop out of my backpack?
faqEntries.content: Some upgrades clash, like the jetpack and the scuba tank. The one that clashes is dropped instead of silently failing, so pick one of the pair.

faqEntries.heading: How do I get all 34 backpack skins?
faqEntries.content: Monsters drop them at a small chance, three spare skins craft into a random new one, and Wandering Peggy sells them for 4-8 emeralds.

item.howToTitle: How to Use the Backpack Add-On

howToEntries.heading: Step 1: Enable the Add-On
howToEntries.content: Open Minecraft, go to Settings > Global Resources, and turn on Backpacks & Stuff. The Behaviour Pack and Resource Pack belong to the same Add-On, so activating it applies both.

howToEntries.heading: Step 2: Add It to Your World
howToEntries.content: Create a new world or edit an existing one. Under Add-Ons, select Backpacks & Stuff under both Behavior Packs and Resource Packs, then play.

howToEntries.heading: Step 3: Craft Your Backpack
howToEntries.content: Place 6 leather around 3 chests on a crafting table. Craft any backpack skin on its own to get the Guide Book, which explains all 13 pages of the Add-On in game.

howToEntries.heading: Step 4: Open It and Wear It
howToEntries.content: Use the backpack in your hand to open it, or put it in your chest slot and sneak + use with an empty hand. It holds 78 items across 3 storage pages.

howToEntries.heading: Step 5: Slot In Your Upgrades
howToEntries.content: The top row holds 4 upgrades. Double crouch to cycle the selected slot, then sneak + attack to fire that upgrades ability. Two of the same upgrade stack their effect, and upgrades that clash - like the jetpack and the scuba tank - drop out instead of failing silently.

howToEntries.heading: Step 6: Collect All 34 Skins
howToEntries.content:
Skins drop from monsters, three spare skins craft into a random new one, and Wandering Peggy sells them for 4-8 emeralds when she passes through with her llamas.
